item.title: Useful Git commands
item.description: TL;DR This post provides a running list for helpful git commands. Note that all user input is identified by angle brackets with capital letters, for example: <INSERT ...>. Additional git references can be found online at the following sites: git documentation; git user manual; GitHub documentation; and, Atlassian tutorials and glossary.
